name: Chain of Rocks Canal Bridge (road, over the navigation canal)
source_note: A published figure exists (480.2 ft) but it's an elevation-datum reading referenced to a specific 'Lock 27 (Chain of Rocks) Upper Gage', not a stage-subtraction like the other bridges here, and no matching NWPS/USGS gauge for that exact reference was found. Deliberately left blank rather than risk computing a wrong number from a mismatched datum. One-lane road bridge over the Chain of Rocks Canal (the ~8.4mi bypass channel most tow traffic actually uses past the Chain of Rocks shoal) — distinct from the old Route 66 Chain of Rocks Bridge, which is pedestrian/bike-only and crosses the natural river channel, not the canal.
notes: NEEDS DATA — clearance unknown, do not assume a value. Verify against the current USACE chart book / Lock 27 gauge before using.
